(2) D15 and D21 (bisbet for bibset, 32:30 and 1:01:34) are the root-letter slip the reader brief names as S4 (بنسبت for بنبسط); I dropped both on that rule although Amal voiced the explanation each time - if Medi wants this specific slip counted it is one B1-shaped pattern across 32:30, 56:04 (ban sebet) and 1:01:34, and the merger can re-file D15 and D21 from the rows the readers wrote. D2 and D9 (verb used where the state word / adjective was wanted) are both filed as grammar B15 (participles, not taught - shown, not counted) rather than vocab tier 2, because a bucket exists and Amal named the word class ('as a siffa') at 27:49; if the merger prefers vocab tier 2 the two rows should move together. Possible added row I did NOT write (not sure): 44:44 he said ابستههم for 'make them happy' and Amal said أبستيهم. Good. - may be her feminine-command recast (she is the addressee) or just her echo.
